sloka: मार्गमाणो वर आरोहाम् राज पुत्रीम् अनिन्दिताम् ।सुख प्रसुप्तान् विहगान् बोधयाम् आस वानरः ॥५-१४-९॥
transliteration: mārgamāṇo vara ārohām rāja putrīm aninditām ।sukha prasuptān vihagān bodhayām āsa vānaraḥ ॥5-14-9॥

translations.english: The vanara who went searching for the paragon of virtue born of a noble family, awakened the birds who were happily asleep in their nests.
